summary: Iteration 66 edge cases + UI checks: backend 11/11 pytest PASS (catalogue export leakage, merge multi-chunk drafts+cleanup, buyer 403, malformed payload, admin manifest excludes db_snapshots/pincodes, admin restore bad-collection & malformed docs are <500, delivery /check with lat/lng only + no location, /api/products?pincode=517644, shop-layout never inlines base64). All four original scripted tests were kept intact (not re-run per instructions). Frontend: /vendor/catalogue-backup renders both Download + Choose file buttons and the vendor-backup-open row is visible on Products tab of /vendor/dashboard; /admin/backups shows the 'Full app backup to a file' entry (backups-file-open testID); /admin/backup-file renders the manifest chips (890 records across 53 collections, users=28, products=16, orders=34 etc) with Download + Choose buttons; buyer shop home renders 7 product cards with delivery header at Srikalahasti 517644. TWO frontend concerns (not necessarily bugs): (1) after clicking 'Download backup' on both the vendor and admin backup-file screens, the result box (testID catalogue-result / appbackup-result) did NOT appear within 30s / 90s in headless Playwright — the underlying Blob<->URL.createObjectURL<->anchor click may succeed silently but setResult never runs OR the download promise never resolves in headless mode; user-side download works in real Chrome; (2) tablet-viewport reload of /shop stalled on the Slangcart splash for >5s, so I could NOT visually confirm the centred-column layout — code review of src/content-width.tsx confirms it caps maxWidth to a fixed value which is correct. NOTE: my initial replace-mode multi-chunk test wiped vendor2 products; I re-seeded 'Vendor Two Gadget' via /app/backend/tests/seed_iter55.py and replaced the test with a merge-mode multi-chunk one that preserves fixtures. Deprecated packages detected: NONE new; RN-Web still emits 'shadow*' and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecation warnings (carried over from previous iterations).

Cannot rule out that downloadText promise never resolves after the Blob anchor click. Please verify manually in Chrome that the ✅ result string surfaces.
Same pattern as above — appbackup-result did not appear within 90s after clicking appbackup-download; manifest & chips render fine but the success confirmation cannot be verified via automation.

integration_issues.flow: login form submit in headless preview
integration_issues.issue: Same carryover blocker as iteration 65: filling login-email-input + login-password-input + clicking login-submit-button does not advance URL in headless Playwright. Worked around by POSTing /api/auth/login and injecting the returned token into localStorage(auth_token, auth_refresh_token). Recommend investigating why the RN-Web login submit does not trigger navigation under headless Chrome — likely a passkey/OTP branch or a redirect eaten by CSP/session.

issues: Second load of /shop at 834x1112 stalled on the Slangcart splash for >5s; code review of src/content-width.tsx confirms max-width cap logic, but the running app could not be visually verified at this viewport in the automation run — manual visual pass recommended.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props deprecated warning across screens — carryover, not new. Reference: multiple RN-Web components.

action_items: Investigate why /vendor/catalogue-backup and /admin/backup-file do NOT surface the ✅ success text (catalogue-result / appbackup-result) in headless web preview — either the Blob<->anchor click blocks the JS turn or setResult is not reached. Verify in real Chrome that the result box appears once the file is downloaded.

Login flow blocker persists — clicking login-submit-button in headless Chrome does not navigate. Add an explicit navigation-guard or ensure the form is a plain onPress-driven fetch so automation can drive login end-to-end.
Manual visual pass at 834x1112 to confirm the centred max-width column and non-stretched layout blocks (automation load stalled on splash).
RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow* / props.pointerEvents) — schedule a migration pass in a future iteration.

Consider preserving vendor2 fixture behaviour by rejecting mode=replace when the vendor has ANY non-restored (owned) products, OR at least surfacing a strong 'this will wipe your entire catalogue' confirmation in the UI. Current API silently deletes ALL vendor products in replace-mode first_chunk, which is destructive.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/backup.py replace-mode wipes ALL of the vendor's products, not only restored drafts (line 130-135). The problem statement's spec says restored products land as HIDDEN DRAFTS but doesn't spell out what replace actually replaces. Consider limiting the wipe to {restored_from_backup: true} unless the UI clearly warns.

core/delivery.py + routes/delivery.py — vendor and customer views AGREE on pincode 517644/517641/near/far and on lat/lng-only queries, so the shared engine is doing what the spec asked. /delivery/check with neither pincode nor lat/lng returns a graceful <500 response.
shop-layout list endpoints correctly return /api/shop-layout/{id}/image URLs (no base64 leaks in public or admin list), and PATCHing a block back with the URL keeps the stored artwork.

Frontend downloadText uses window.URL.createObjectURL + anchor.click on web — this pattern is fine for real browsers but Playwright's download event only fires when Content-Disposition is set OR anchor has download attribute. downloadText DOES set the download attribute — the missing result box is likely a JS timing/state issue, not the download itself.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 edge cases + 4/4 pre-existing scripted smoke tests reported PASS by main agent)
success_rate.frontend: 6/8 verified — screens render + backup row visible + admin manifest chips + shop home cards; 2/8 unverifiable in headless (result box on downloads, tablet layout)

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter66_edge_cases.py runs 11 tests in ~7s against the public preview and is safe to re-run — it uses merge-mode only on vendor2 and cleans up every restored draft. Login form still doesn't advance in headless — the pattern that works everywhere is: POST /api/auth/login + localStorage.setItem('auth_token', ...) + localStorage.setItem('auth_refresh_token', ...) then navigate. Danger PIN hash is temporarily set to hash('135790') during the run and restored in teardown.
